name: Killing Madness (General)
body:
Creatures cannot live with the effects your powers place upon their mind.

Benefit(s): Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 sanity or deal enough damage to a mental ability score that the damage exceeds that ability score, the creature dies rather than suffering from the normal effects. Creatures killed in this way cannot be raised by any effect save for reality revision or similarly powerful magic.
